name: Greek Groove
description: Annual Greek Life event hosted by Panhellenic and IFC at which Greek organizations participate in a dance competition. Tickets to the event will be sold at the event.

name: Formal Dress Drive Donation and Rental Drop Off
description: We are hosting a dress drive for girls to donate or offer their dresses for rental for other girls to wear during the Greek life formal season! This is solely for dress drop-off, not shopping/selecting dresses yet!
location: Greek Life Office in Trone in Student Org Commons

name: Greek Groove
description: Greek sororities and fraternities will have a dance competition for charity on Tuesday Nov 16 at 7:00-9:00. All are welcome and encouraged to come out and support.

name: Kickball Kickoff for Greek Week
description: Fraternities and sororities will get up to the plate to kick off the infamous Greek Week. They will compete in a classic round robin of kickball at the north village fields at 7:00 on Monday Nov 15!

name: Yoga at the Amphitheater
description: This event will be a yoga night, with a Furman student yoga instructor. This particular event is to be a part of Panhellenic and IFC’s philanthropy event of the semester and we will be the sponsors. The nonprofit we are supporting is Mental Health America of Greenville County. We are also using this time to help students destress and find good coping mechanisms for dealing with mental health.
